source: bench/real29/r_a29_market (Anchor 0.29.0, solana-program 1.16.27, written for the bench)
about: Realistic clean program: every finding on it is false. Scored for rules only. Market / Listing are Anchor accounts (owner + discriminator on load).

why.admin: Signer with address = ADMIN (hard-coded): only the deployer's admin initializes; pays the market rent and funds the fee vault's rent-exempt minimum.
why.market: init at the constant PDA [market]: once.
PDA [market] / stored bump, has_one = admin; fee_bps <= 500.

why.new_admin: Signer: the new admin accepts in the same transaction.

why.fee_vault: SystemAccount at PDA [fee_vault] / market.fee_vault_bump; system transfer signed with those seeds; amount <= balance - rent minimum.
why.destination: Any account the admin picks (UncheckedAccount by design).

why.seller: Signer; pays both rents and signs the deposit (token authority).
why.listing: init at PDA [listing, seller, mint]: fresh, bound to the seller and mint.
why.escrow: init token account at PDA [escrow, listing] with the listing PDA as authority.

why.seller: Signer, the stored seller. Buyers are protected by max_price in buy.
Signer; the listing PDA seeds use seller.key() and has_one = seller; receives both rents (close = seller, CloseAccount destination).
why.listing: PDA [listing, seller, listing.mint] / bump, has_one seller / escrow, close = seller; signs the escrow transfer and close.
why.seller_token: token::mint = listing.mint; the seller's own choice of destination.

why.buyer: Signer; pays price * amount (checked) by system transfers from its own account; price <= max_price.
why.listing: PDA [listing, listing.seller, listing.mint] / bump, has_one = escrow; amount <= remaining; signs the escrow transfer.
why.seller: address = listing.seller: the proceeds can only go to the seller.
why.buyer_token: token::mint = listing.mint; the buyer's choice of destination.

why.listing: PDA / bump, has_one escrow / seller, constraint remaining == 0 (NotSoldOut), close = seller. Permissionless by design: closes a sold-out listing, every lamport goes to the stored seller.
why.escrow: equal to listing.escrow; closed by CloseAccount signed by the listing PDA (the token program requires a zero balance).
why.seller: has_one = seller: the rents can only go to the seller.
